snippet: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless Customer provides written notice of non-renewal at least 30 calendar days prior to the expiration of the then-current term.
explanation: Automatic renewal with 30 calendar days notice required from the company is within the 60-day limit.

snippet: The term will automatically renew for subsequent twelve-month periods unless the Company delivers written notice of termination at least 60 calendar days before the renewal date.
explanation: Automatic renewal notice of exactly 60 calendar days meets the policy threshold.

snippet: Agreement automatically extends unless Client provides written notice of non-renewal no later than 61 calendar days prior to end of term.
explanation: Notice period of 61 calendar days exceeds the maximum permitted 60-day threshold.

snippet: Unless Buyer delivers written notice of non-renewal at least 90 calendar days prior to the renewal date, this Agreement shall automatically renew.
explanation: Notice period of 90 calendar days exceeds the 60-day company policy limit.

snippet: Each Order Form renews automatically for successive annual terms unless Customer serves notice of cancellation at least 120 calendar days in advance.
explanation: Notice period of 120 calendar days is substantially above the 60-day threshold and requires legal exception approval.

snippet: Either party may prevent automatic renewal by providing written notification no later than 15 calendar days before term expiration.
explanation: Notice period of 15 calendar days is well within the 60 calendar-day maximum.

snippet: This contract automatically renews unless the Company gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 business days prior to renewal.
explanation: Notice is specified in business days rather than calendar days, which exceeds 60 calendar days and requires manual review.

snippet: The subscription shall automatically renew unless Customer submits notice of termination at least two months before expiration.
explanation: Notice specified in months cannot be presumed to be 60 calendar days and requires review.

snippet: Agreement automatically renews for one year unless Company notifies Supplier at least 90 prior to expiration.
explanation: The notice period number is given without an explicit time unit, requiring human review.

snippet: The contract mentions that services will continue under an evergreen structure, but no section specifies the notice timeline or procedure to terminate renewal.
explanation: No usable contractual provision defining the renewal notice timeline was located.

snippet: This Agreement shall terminate upon the expiration date and shall not renew automatically under any circumstances.
explanation: The contract expressly excludes automatic renewal, making the renewal notice rule not applicable.

snippet: Section 2.1 requires Customer to give 30 calendar days notice to prevent renewal, whereas Section 8.4 of the Master Terms states 90 calendar days notice is required.
explanation: Conflicting notice periods (30 vs 90 calendar days) across contract sections require manual legal review.

snippet: Company may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time by providing 30 days written notice to Service Provider.
explanation: The company possesses an unambiguous affirmative right to terminate for convenience.

snippet: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience immediately upon delivering written notice to the other party.
explanation: Mutual right allows the company to terminate for convenience immediately.

snippet: Neither party, and specifically Customer, shall have any right to terminate this Agreement for convenience or without cause prior to the expiration of the initial term.
explanation: The contract explicitly deprives the company of any right to terminate for convenience.

snippet: Company may terminate this Agreement exclusively in the event of an uncured material breach by Vendor following 30 days written cure notice.
explanation: Company termination is expressly limited to material breach for cause, with no convenience termination permitted.

snippet: Supplier reserves the right to terminate this Agreement without cause upon 60 days notice. The agreement contains no provision addressing Customer termination.
explanation: Only the vendor's termination for convenience is addressed, leaving the company's right unestablished.

snippet: A thorough review of the contract reveals terms covering payment, deliverables, and warranties, but no termination for convenience clause.
explanation: No clause addressing termination for convenience was found in the contract.

snippet: Customer may terminate for convenience subject to satisfaction of operational milestones and undefined transition protocols mutually agreed in good faith.
explanation: The company's right is conditioned on vague and undefined transition obligations, requiring review.

snippet: Clause 5.2 states Customer may cancel at will upon 30 days notice, while Clause 11.1 states this Agreement is non-cancellable prior to term expiration.
explanation: Internal contradiction between clauses granting and prohibiting convenience termination requires legal review.

snippet: Buyer may terminate this Contract without cause at its sole discretion upon ninety (90) calendar days prior written notice.
explanation: Affirmative company termination right without cause is compliant regardless of the 90-day notice period.

snippet: Client rights to terminate are strictly limited to instances of uncured material breach or insolvency of Contractor.
explanation: Contract explicitly restricts company termination to cause, triggering a policy exception.

snippet: Either party or the designated representative may terminate without cause by giving 30 days notice, but the governing definition of 'party' is ambiguous.
explanation: The clause does not clearly identify whether the company is an authorized terminating party.

snippet: Pursuant to Amendment No. 1, Section 4.3, Customer retains the express right to terminate the Agreement without penalty or cause upon 45 days written notice.
explanation: The included amendment explicitly establishes the company's right to terminate for convenience.

snippet: The aggregate liability of Company arising out of or related to this Agreement shall in no event exceed $100,000, and no uncapped carve-outs apply.
explanation: Company liability has a clear aggregate monetary limit with no uncapped exceptions.

snippet: Each party's total cumulative liability under this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by Customer in the preceding twelve months.
explanation: Mutual liability cap clearly caps the company's liability without carve-outs.

snippet: Customer's liability for any damages or defaults arising under this Agreement shall be unlimited and subject to no aggregate cap.
explanation: The contract expressly imposes unlimited liability on the company, triggering a policy exception.

snippet: Company liability is capped at $50,000, provided that liability arising from breach of Section 7 (Confidentiality) shall be entirely uncapped.
explanation: An explicit uncapped carve-out for company confidentiality breaches creates uncontained liability.

snippet: Vendor liability is uncapped for gross negligence; Customer's total liability under all causes of action is strictly capped at $25,000.
explanation: Vendor uncapped exposure does not impair the clearly established cap on company liability.

snippet: Vendor's liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the contract value. The agreement contains no provision capping Customer's liability.
explanation: Liability cap protects only the vendor, leaving company exposure unaddressed.

snippet: The document contains operational SLA and invoicing schedules, but contains no limitation of liability or liability cap provision.
explanation: No limitation of liability provision was identified in the contract.

snippet: Section 9 limits Customer exposure to $10,000, while Schedule C stipulates that Customer indemnity obligations are uncapped.
explanation: Contradictory limitation terms between general terms and Schedule C require legal review.

snippet: Customer aggregate liability is capped at $500,000, except that Customer intellectual property indemnification obligations under Section 12 shall be uncapped.
explanation: An explicit uncapped indemnification carve-out for the company requires policy exception approval.

snippet: Company liability shall not exceed the applicable fees set forth in the unexecuted Service Annex.
explanation: The liability cap references undefined or unattached fees, preventing determination of the actual monetary limit.

snippet: Both parties are capped at $200,000, provided that Vendor's liability for data protection breaches shall be uncapped; no carve-outs apply to Company.
explanation: Uncapped carve-outs apply solely to the vendor, while the company's liability remains strictly capped.

snippet: Direct damages recoverable from Customer are capped at $50,000, but consequential, indirect, and special damages provisions remain undefined.
explanation: Cap covers only direct damages with ambiguous treatment of other damage categories, requiring review.
